name: Acid Touch
body:
School conjuration (creation) [acid]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature or object touched
Duration 1 round + 1 round per three levels
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Your successful melee touch attack deals 3d4 points of acid damage. For every three caster levels you possess, the acid, unless neutralized, lasts for another round (to a maximum of 6 additional rounds at 18th level), dealing another 3d4 points of damage in each round.
